summary: Wallowa lookout: a 24-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1941, removed in 1952; one named lookout and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 24-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1952 per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed that year

staffing.status: one named lookout, Duley (Duly) Dale of Enterprise; 1941 per Forest Lookouts, 1942-1943 per firelookout.com

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Wallowa-Whitman National Forest per the register; Wallowa National Forest per Forest Lookouts)

events.note: 24-foot pole L-4 tower, per the register and firelookout.com
Duley Dale of Enterprise, first and only lookout to man the tower, per Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com dates Dale to 1942-1943
firelookout.com lists Dale for 1942-1943, which conflicts with the 1941 date
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1952
Date registered August 21, 2011 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts says 1941 was the only year a lookout was assigned and spells the name Duley. firelookout.com lists Duly Dale for 1942-1943. The story gives both and does not choose.
The register names the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest; Forest Lookouts uses the older Wallowa National Forest name for the same land.

sources.title: Square Mountain Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no height in the brief, so height_m 7.3 is the register's 24 feet converted. Staffing dates conflict (1941 vs 1942-1943) and the name is spelled Duley or Duly. No source describes the site now or public access. The register says removed and firelookout.com says destroyed, both for 1952.
